name: expressions_keyed
note: account.report.expression (addons/account/models/account_report.py): every expression keyed by id with its report line, label, engine and figure type (the (report_line_id, label) unique index is checked by Tier 1)
source_sql: SELECT id, report_line_id, label, engine, figure_type FROM account_report_expression ORDER BY id

name: external_values_per_expression
note: account.report.external.value (target_report_expression_id) embedded as accountReportExpression.accountReportExternalValue: external values per expression; expressions without values excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT target_report_expression_id AS expression_id, count(*) AS external_values FROM account_report_external_value GROUP BY target_report_expression_id ORDER BY target_report_expression_id
